maddeler.e:
أقتطف (form VIII)
# أَقْتَطِفُ (ʔaqtaṭifu) /ʔaq.ta.tˤi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# أُقْتَطَفُ (ʔuqtaṭafu) /ʔuq.ta.tˤa.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# أَقْتَطِفَ (ʔaqtaṭifa) /ʔaq.ta.tˤi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# أُقْتَطَفَ (ʔuqtaṭafa) /ʔuq.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
